note: 字典快照（#56 门禁）：每个 key 的 en/zh/draft 冻结在此。改文案必须同步本文件（diff 里看得见），改文案不换 key；增删 key 同样要同步。--update-snapshot 重算。

batch.action.check-title.zh: 重新读取批量状态（只读）

batch.action.close-title.en: Close the window; batch progress keeps running
batch.action.close-title.zh: 关闭窗口，批量更新不受影响

batch.action.discard.en: Discard this unfinished batch (installed ones stay)
batch.action.discard.zh: 丢弃本批未完成的更新（已完成的将保留）。

batch.action.install-all-title.en: Submit all updatable plugins at once; one idempotency key per session
batch.action.install-all-title.zh: 将有更新的插件一次提交；同一会话使用同一幂等编号。

batch.action.resume.zh: 继续上次未完成的更新（剩余 {count} 个）。

batch.action.resume-title.en: Continue from where it stopped; installed ones stay
batch.action.resume-title.zh: 从上次中断处继续安装，已完成的不会重复安装。

batch.banner.age-gated.en: {n} plugin(s) are blocked by the 24-hour age gate.
batch.banner.age-gated.zh: {n} 个插件的最新版被 24 小时年龄门挡住。

batch.banner.compliant-done.en: {title}: installed {version}, not the latest {target} (the latest did not go through).
batch.banner.compliant-done.zh: {title}：已装 {version}，不是最新 {target}（最新版没装成）。

batch.banner.compliant-done-gated.en: {title}: installed {version}; the latest {target} is still blocked by the 24-hour age gate (installable in about {time}).
batch.banner.compliant-done-gated.zh: {title}：已装 {version}；最新 {target} 仍被 24 小时年龄门挡着，约 {time} 后可装。

batch.banner.compliant-done-title.en: Actual install result for these {n} plugin(s):
batch.banner.compliant-done-title.zh: 这 {n} 个插件的实际安装结果：

batch.banner.error-action-fallback.en: Retry once first; if it persists, send the copied diagnostics to the plugin author.
batch.banner.error-action-fallback.zh: 请重试一次；若持续，请提交诊断信息至插件作者。

batch.banner.failed-action.en: Retry each one inline; if it keeps failing, send the copied diagnostics to the plugin author.
batch.banner.failed-action.zh: 请逐家使用行内「重试」；若持续，请提交诊断信息至插件作者。

batch.banner.gated-wait.en: {n} plugin(s) are blocked by the 24-hour age gate and nothing is installable right now; installable in about {time}.
batch.banner.gated-wait.zh: {n} 个插件的最新版被 24 小时年龄门挡住，现在还没有可装的版本；约 {time} 后可装。

batch.banner.loading.zh: 正在读取批量更新状态…

batch.banner.restart-action.en: Restart the host to run the new version; this is a normal end state, not a failure.
batch.banner.restart-action.zh: 重启宿主以加载新版本；此为正常状态，非安装失败。

batch.banner.restart-title.en: {n} installed; restart the host to take effect.
batch.banner.restart-title.zh: {n} 个已安装完成，重启宿主后生效。

batch.fact.close-safe.en: Closing this panel won't stop it — progress is saved on disk.
batch.fact.close-safe.zh: 关闭面板不会中断更新：进度已保存，可随时返回继续。

batch.hint.done.en: All up to date; nothing to do.
batch.hint.done.zh: 已全部为最新，无需操作。

batch.hint.empty.en: No targets yet: select “Check for updates” to see which plugins have updates.
batch.hint.empty.zh: 暂无目标：请选择「检查更新」查看哪些插件有更新。

batch.hint.error.en: Last run failed: follow the red banner below.
batch.hint.error.zh: 上次执行失败：请按下方红色横幅提示操作。

batch.hint.failed.en: {n} failed to install; retry each one from the failure notes below.
batch.hint.failed.zh: {n} 个插件安装失败；请按下方失败提示逐项重试。

batch.hint.installing-auto.zh: 正在安装 {a} 个，完成后自动安装下一项。

batch.hint.installing-queueable.en: Installing {a}; {b} more can join the queue.
batch.hint.installing-queueable.zh: 正在安装 {a} 个；另有 {b} 个可选择「加入队列」等待。

batch.hint.pending.en: {n} not checked yet; select “Check for updates” for a round.
batch.hint.pending.zh: {n} 个尚未查询；请选择「检查更新」查询一轮。

batch.hint.restart.en: {n} installed; restart the host to take effect.
batch.hint.restart.zh: {n} 个已安装完成，重启宿主后生效。

batch.hint.updatable.en: {n} updates available; select “Update all” to install at once, or install each one inline.
batch.hint.updatable.zh: {n} 个可更新；请选择「全部更新」一次安装完成，也可逐项选择「安装此插件」。

batch.notice.auto-resumed.zh: 已自动继续上次未完成的更新（剩余 {count} 个）。

batch.notice.busy-cancel.en: An install is running and cannot be stopped.
batch.notice.busy-cancel.zh: 正在安装的项无法停止。

batch.notice.cancel-confirm.zh: 请再次选择以确认丢弃。

batch.notice.discarded.en: Discarded this unfinished batch (installed ones stay).
batch.notice.discarded.zh: 已丢弃本批未完成的更新（已完成的将保留）。

batch.notice.resumed.zh: 已继续上次未完成的更新（剩余 {count} 个）。

batch.row.checking.zh: 正在查询版本信息，请稍候。

batch.row.compliant-done.en: Installed {version}, not the latest {target} (the latest did not go through)
batch.row.compliant-done.zh: 已装 {version}，不是最新 {target}（最新版这次没装上）

batch.row.cta-generic.en: Select “Install this plugin” to install the new version
batch.row.cta-generic.zh: 选择「安装此插件」安装新版本

batch.row.done-restart.en: Installed; restart the host to take effect
batch.row.done-restart.zh: 已安装完成，重启宿主后生效。

batch.row.failed-retry.en: Install failed; select “Retry” to try again

batch.row.queued-generic.en: Queued · waiting for the running install to finish
batch.row.queued-generic.zh: 已排队 · 等待前方安装完成

batch.row.queued-n.zh: 已排队 · 前方还有 {n} 项

batch.row.skipped-idle.en: This version is skipped; nothing to do
batch.row.skipped-idle.zh: 该版本已跳过，无需操作。

batch.row.unknown.en: Unknown state; select “Check for updates” to check again
batch.row.unknown.zh: 状态无法识别，请选择「检查更新」重新查询。

batch.row.wait-turn.en: Waiting for its turn; it will check automatically
batch.row.wait-turn.zh: 请等待，轮到将自动查询版本信息。

batch.setting.check-on-open.zh: 打开面板时自动检查更新

batch.toast.cancel-fail.en: Could not cancel the queue (it may have started installing); see the latest state below.
batch.toast.cancel-fail.zh: 取消排队失败（可能已开始安装）：请查看下方最新状态。

batch.toast.cancel-ok.en: Queue cancelled: this plugin will not wait.
batch.toast.cancel-ok.zh: 已取消排队：此插件将不再等待。

batch.toast.cancel-unavailable.en: This row carries no phone or ID to cancel the queue; try again after the next refresh.
batch.toast.cancel-unavailable.zh: 此行缺少取消排队所需的信息，暂无法取消；请待下次刷新后重试。

batch.toast.compliant-installed.en: Requested {a} compliant build(s) (not the latest: it is still age-gated); {b} did not go through.
batch.toast.compliant-installed.zh: 已请求安装 {a} 个合规版（不是最新版：最新版仍被年龄门挡着）；{b} 个没装成。

batch.toast.copy-all-diag-ok.en: Diagnostics for {n} plugin(s) copied; paste them to the plugin author (already redacted).
batch.toast.copy-all-diag-ok.zh: 已复制 {n} 家插件的诊断，请提交至插件作者（已脱敏）。

batch.toast.copy-all-manual-ok.en: {n} manual command(s) copied (plugins without a command are marked as # comments); paste them into the terminal line by line.
batch.toast.copy-all-manual-ok.zh: 已复制 {n} 条手工命令（无命令的插件已用 # 注释标注），请粘贴至终端逐行执行。

batch.toast.copy-diag-ok.en: Diagnostics copied; paste it to the plugin author (already redacted).
batch.toast.copy-diag-ok.zh: 诊断信息已复制，请提交至插件作者（已脱敏）。

batch.toast.copy-fail.en: Copy failed; please select the info above manually.
batch.toast.copy-fail.zh: 复制失败，请手动选择上方信息。

batch.toast.copy-manual-ok.en: Manual command copied; paste the full line into the terminal to run it.
batch.toast.copy-manual-ok.zh: 手工命令已复制，请粘贴至终端整行执行。

batch.toast.queue-missed.en: Another install is running: this plugin is not queued yet; try again after it finishes.
batch.toast.queue-missed.zh: 前方仍在安装：此插件尚未排队，请待前方安装完成后再次选择。

batch.toast.restart-delegated.en: Handled by the caller’s restart flow; the new version takes effect after restart.
batch.toast.restart-delegated.zh: 已按调用方重启流程处理；重启后新版本生效。

batch.toast.restart-failed.en: Restart entry failed; please restart the host manually. The new version takes effect after restart.
batch.toast.restart-failed.zh: 重启入口调用失败，请手动重启宿主；重启后新版本生效。

batch.toast.restart-manual.en: This host provides no restart entry; please restart the host manually. The new version takes effect after restart.
batch.toast.restart-manual.zh: 本宿主未提供重启入口，请手动重启宿主；重启后新版本生效。

batch.toast.skipped.en: Skipped {version}: no further reminders for this version; select “Restore” to undo.
batch.toast.skipped.zh: 已跳过版本 {version}：该版本不再提醒；选择「恢复提醒」可撤销。

batch.toast.unskipped-version.en: Restored {version}: reminders for this version are back on.
batch.toast.unskipped-version.zh: 已恢复 {version}：该版本将正常提醒。

changelog.neutral.line.en: No changelog provided. Install is not affected.
changelog.neutral.line.zh: 作者未提供更新说明，安装不受影响。

changelog.security.note.en: Remaining entries are collapsed to keep the panel fast. See the original text.
changelog.security.note.zh: 为保持面板性能，其余条目已折叠，请查看原文。

changelog.truncated.count.zh: 共 {m} 条，仅显示前 {n} 条

changelog.truncated.file.en: This log is larger than 64 KiB; only the first part is rendered.
changelog.truncated.file.zh: 日志过长，超出上限的部分没有渲染。

changelog.truncated.versions.zh: 其后还有 {n} 个版本未显示。

changelog.yanked.banner.en: Version {version} was yanked by the author. Install is not affected. Please confirm before proceeding.
changelog.yanked.banner.zh: 目标版本 {version} 已被作者撤回（yanked），安装不受影响，继续前请确认。

diag.cause.age.other.timed.en: The installer reports: another package in the same environment, {package}, was rejected by a supply-chain age policy — not a problem with this plugin itself (see the summary). Retry after {time}; or ask the host to relax the policy.
diag.cause.age.other.timed.zh: 安装器报告：同环境另一包 {package} 因供应链年龄策略被拒，不是本插件的直接问题（见摘要）。{time}后重试；或找宿主放宽策略。

diag.cause.age.other.untimed.en: The installer reports: another package in the same environment, {package}, was rejected by a supply-chain age policy — not a problem with this plugin itself (see the summary). Retry later, or ask the host to relax the policy.
diag.cause.age.other.untimed.zh: 安装器报告：同环境另一包 {package} 因供应链年龄策略被拒，不是本插件的直接问题（见摘要）。请稍后重试，或找宿主放宽策略。

diag.cause.age.target.timed.en: Your plugin {package} was published too recently and was blocked by the host supply-chain age policy (installer words in the summary). Retry after {time}; for urgent use ask the host to relax the policy.
diag.cause.age.target.timed.zh: 本插件 {package} 发布未满宿主年龄门限，被供应链策略拦截（安装器原话见摘要）。{time}后点重试即可；急用请找宿主放宽策略。

diag.cause.age.target.untimed.en: Your plugin {package} was blocked by the host supply-chain age policy because it is too new (see the summary). Retry later; for urgent use ask the host to relax the policy.
diag.cause.age.target.untimed.zh: 本插件 {package} 因太新被宿主供应链年龄策略拦截（见摘要）。请稍后重试；急用请找宿主放宽策略。

diag.fallback.channel-mismatch.en: Installed version is not in the selected release channel
diag.fallback.channel-mismatch.zh: 已安装版本与当前版本通道不符

diag.fallback.dev-source.en: Dev-mode source link; update center unavailable
diag.fallback.dev-source.zh: 开发态源码链接，更新中心不可用

diag.fallback.http-status.zh: 数据源返回 {status}，重试后仍失败。

diag.fallback.incompatible-node.en: New version needs a different Node version than the running one
diag.fallback.incompatible-node.zh: Node 运行时版本不兼容

diag.fallback.invalid-release.en: Version in the manifest is not valid
diag.fallback.invalid-release.zh: 清单文件中版本号非法

diag.fallback.pending-restart.en: New version is on disk. The running version is still the old one.
diag.fallback.pending-restart.zh: 新版本已写入磁盘，当前运行仍为旧版本

diag.fallback.rate-limited.en: Source returned 429. Too many requests this minute.
diag.fallback.rate-limited.zh: 数据源返回 429，本分钟请求过于频繁。

diag.fallback.recovery-required.en: Last install was interrupted, leaving a partial task
diag.fallback.recovery-required.zh: 上次安装异常中断，存在未完成任务

diag.fallback.registry-conflict.en: Declared version conflicts with the on-disk version
diag.fallback.registry-conflict.zh: 版本声明与磁盘实际版本冲突

diag.fallback.revalidate-fetch.zh: 安装前复验失败，未能获取版本信息

diag.fallback.source-install.en: Installed from source, not by version
diag.fallback.source-install.zh: 源码安装实例，不支持版本更新

diag.fallback.unknown-profile.en: Scope or plugin location not recognized
diag.fallback.unknown-profile.zh: 无法识别使用范围或插件安装位置

panel.action.check-title.en: Check the official source once more (read-only, never installs)
panel.action.check-title.zh: 重新向官方源查询版本信息（只读，不安装）

panel.action.checking-busy-title.en: Checking the official source; please wait
panel.action.checking-busy-title.zh: 正在向官方源查询版本信息，请稍候

panel.action.copy-diag-title.en: Copy redacted diagnostics for the plugin author
panel.action.copy-diag-title.zh: 复制已脱敏诊断，请提交至插件作者

panel.action.copy-manual-title.en: Copy the manual command; paste the full line into the terminal
panel.action.copy-manual-title.zh: 复制手工命令，请粘贴至终端整行执行

panel.action.dismiss-title.en: Acknowledge the failure and return; next check or install will re-evaluate
panel.action.dismiss-title.zh: 确认已知晓该失败：返回可安装页，下次查询或安装将重新评估

panel.action.install-fallback-confirm-ti.zh: 点下去即安装该精确版本

panel.action.install-fallback-title.en: Resolve an age-compliant version first, then confirm; never installs an older version silently
panel.action.install-fallback-title.zh: 先决议一个满门限的版本再请你确认，不会静默装旧版

panel.action.install-gated-title.en: Come back {unlock} to install {latest}; it is still gated and would fail now.
panel.action.install-gated-title.zh: {unlock}再来装 {latest} 吧，现在装会被门拦住。

panel.action.install-title.en: Install the exact version; one install per scope at a time
panel.action.install-title.zh: 按精确版本安装；同一使用范围同时仅安装一项

panel.action.restart-host-title.en: Run the caller restart flow if available, otherwise restart DSH manually
panel.action.restart-host-title.zh: 优先走调用方重启流程；若无，请手动重启 DSH

panel.action.skip-title.en: This version will no longer notify; newer versions still will
panel.action.skip-title.zh: 该版本将不再提醒；更新的版本仍会正常提醒

panel.action.unskip-title.en: Undo skip; this version will remind again
panel.action.unskip-title.zh: 撤销跳过，该版本将重新提醒

panel.action.wait-latest-title.en: Dismiss this failure; install again once the latest clears the age gate
panel.action.wait-latest-title.zh: 收起这次失败；最新版满门限后可再装

panel.banner.done.en: Up to date. No update needed.

panel.banner.error.action-fallback.en: Copy the diagnostics for the plugin author; see the log channel for details.
panel.banner.error.action-fallback.zh: 请复制诊断信息提交至插件作者；详情请查看日志通道。

panel.banner.installing-action.en: Progress refreshes automatically; reopening the panel restores the view within a second.
panel.banner.installing-action.zh: 进度将自动轮询刷新；重新打开面板将在 1 秒内恢复显示。

panel.banner.installing-title.en: Installing {version}… Closing the panel won’t interrupt it.
panel.banner.installing-title.zh: 正在安装 {version}…关闭面板不会中断。

panel.banner.restart-title.en: Version {latest} is installed; restart the host to take effect.
panel.banner.restart-title.zh: 新版本 {latest} 已安装，重启宿主后生效。

panel.banner.update-action.en: Install runs the exact version; only one install runs per scope at a time.
panel.banner.update-action.zh: 选择安装将按精确版本安装；同一使用范围同时仅安装一项。

panel.banner.update-gated-title.en: Version {latest} was just published and is still gated ({unlock}); installing now will fail — use Install fallback build below if you cannot wait.
panel.banner.update-gated-title.zh: 新版本 {latest} 刚发布未满门，{unlock}可装；现在点安装会失败，等不及可先装合规版。

panel.banner.update-title.zh: 有新版本 {latest} 可安装（当前版本 {running}）。

panel.blocked.channel-mismatch.action.en: Switch to the prerelease channel, or install the channel release, then check again.
panel.blocked.channel-mismatch.action.zh: 切换至预发布通道，或重新安装本通道正式版本后查询

panel.blocked.channel-mismatch.title.en: Installed version is not in the selected release channel
panel.blocked.channel-mismatch.title.zh: 已安装版本与当前版本通道不符

panel.blocked.dev-source.action.en: Edit the repo and restart the host to take effect; the update center only serves version installs, no manual command is provided here.
panel.blocked.dev-source.action.zh: 改完仓库代码后重启宿主生效；更新中心只服务按版本安装，此场景不提供手工命令

panel.blocked.dev-source.title.en: Dev-mode source link, update center unavailable
panel.blocked.dev-source.title.zh: 开发态挂载（源码链接），更新中心不可用

panel.blocked.incompatible-node.action.en: Upgrade Node to 22 or later, then check again.
panel.blocked.incompatible-node.action.zh: 请升级 Node 至 22 或更高版本后重新查询

panel.blocked.incompatible-node.title.en: Required Node version does not match the running Node
panel.blocked.incompatible-node.title.zh: Node 运行时版本不兼容

panel.blocked.installation-changed.actio.en: Reopen the host and check again; if it persists, reinstall.
panel.blocked.installation-changed.actio.zh: 重启宿主后重新查询；若持续，请重新安装

panel.blocked.installation-changed.title.en: Install location changed during use (directory or package changed)
panel.blocked.installation-changed.title.zh: 安装位置发生变更（目录或包体不一致）

panel.blocked.invalid-installation.actio.en: Reinstall the current version to repair the install directory, then check again.
panel.blocked.invalid-installation.actio.zh: 重新安装当前版本以修复安装目录，然后重新查询更新

panel.blocked.invalid-installation.title.en: Installed package is incomplete (name mismatch, invalid version, or missing entry file)
panel.blocked.invalid-installation.title.zh: 已安装包结构不完整（包名 / 版本号 / 入口文件异常）

panel.blocked.pending-restart.action.en: Restart the host to run the new version; this is a normal end state, not a failure.
panel.blocked.pending-restart.action.zh: 重启宿主以加载新版本；此为正常状态，非安装失败

panel.blocked.pending-restart.title.en: New version is on disk; the running instance is still the old version
panel.blocked.pending-restart.title.zh: 新版本已写入磁盘，当前运行仍为旧版本

panel.blocked.recovery-required.action.en: Run install once more; if it persists, follow section 6 to troubleshoot.
panel.blocked.recovery-required.action.zh: 重新执行安装；若持续，请按第 6 节排错

panel.blocked.recovery-required.title.en: Last install was interrupted, leaving a partial task
panel.blocked.recovery-required.title.zh: 上次安装异常中断，存在未完成任务

panel.blocked.registry-conflict.action.en: Open the scope manifest and set the target package line to the version number, then retry.
panel.blocked.registry-conflict.action.zh: 核对使用范围清单文件中目标包的版本声明，修正后重试

panel.blocked.registry-conflict.title.en: Declared version conflicts with the version on disk
panel.blocked.registry-conflict.title.zh: 版本声明与磁盘实际版本冲突

panel.blocked.source-install.action.en: No manual command is provided here; to update, reinstall by version first.
panel.blocked.source-install.action.zh: 此场景不提供手工命令；如需更新，请按包名@版本号重新安装

panel.blocked.source-install.title.en: Installed from source, not by version
panel.blocked.source-install.title.zh: 源码安装实例，不支持版本更新

panel.blocked.unknown-profile.action.en: Reopen the host and check again; if it persists, send the version and logs to the plugin author; no manual command is provided for this case.
panel.blocked.unknown-profile.action.zh: 重启宿主后重新查询；若持续，请提交版本号与诊断信息至插件作者；此场景不提供手工命令

panel.blocked.unknown-profile.title.zh: 无法识别使用范围或插件安装位置

panel.changelog.unavailable.en: Could not read logs; install is unaffected.
panel.changelog.unavailable.zh: 更新日志无法读取，安装不受影响。

panel.changelog.unavailable-empty.en: No release found yet; logs will show after a check.
panel.changelog.unavailable-empty.zh: 尚未查询到新版本；查询到后将显示更新日志。

panel.diag.copy.no-detail.en: (This response carries no diagnostic summary; it will be completed when phone-side diag lands)
panel.diag.copy.no-detail.zh: （本响应未携带诊断摘要，待诊断信息就绪后补全）

panel.error.code-note.en: The line above tells you what to do; to report upstream, paste “Copy diagnostics” as a whole (already redacted).
panel.error.code-note.zh: 上方中文说明即需执行的操作；如需向上游反馈，请使用「复制诊断」整段粘贴（已脱敏）。

panel.error.evidence-frozen.en: Evidence frozen: the code, versions, and IDs in copied diagnostics are from the failure moment and do not refresh with polling; the next check or install will update them.
panel.error.evidence-frozen.zh: 证据已冻结：复制诊断中的稳定码、版本与编号均取自失败时刻，不随轮询刷新；下次查询版本信息或安装将更新。

panel.error.evidence-transient.en: Transient read failure: it clears on the next successful read; if it persists, troubleshoot by stable code.
panel.error.evidence-transient.zh: 瞬态读取失败：下次成功读取将自动解除；若持续出现，请按稳定码排查。

panel.error.log-follow.en: Match the request/check IDs above in {eFail}; baseline timing in {eCall}, execution result in {eExec}.
panel.error.log-follow.zh: 凭上方请求／检查编号在 {eFail} 中匹配；基线耗时请查看 {eCall}，执行结果请查看 {eExec}。

panel.error.log-hint.en: Check logs: {dir} (one directory per plugin, no overlap). Read them with {cmd}; filter by plugin ID {pluginId} for events {e1}, {e2}, {e3}.
panel.error.log-hint.zh: 请查看日志：{dir}（一个插件一棵目录，互不覆盖）。一条命令看：{cmd}；按插件标识 {pluginId} 筛选 {e1}、{e2}、{e3} 事件。

panel.error.no-failure.en: No failure: copying diagnostics gives the current state snapshot.
panel.error.no-failure.zh: 暂无失败：此时复制诊断提供的是当前状态快照。

panel.error.query-keys.en: Query keys: {keys} (use them to match in logs).
panel.error.query-keys.zh: 本次查询键：{keys}（可凭此在日志中检索匹配）。

panel.failure.check-expired.action.en: Check for updates again before installing; do not retry with the old ID.
panel.failure.check-expired.action.zh: 请重新查询版本信息后安装；请勿复用过期请求编号

panel.failure.check-expired.title.en: Credentials expired; the install request was rejected
panel.failure.check-expired.title.zh: 查询凭证过期，安装请求被拒绝

panel.failure.check-failed.action.en: Try checking again later; if it keeps failing, send the copied diagnostics to the plugin author.
panel.failure.check-failed.action.zh: 稍后重新查询；若持续，请提交诊断信息至插件作者

panel.failure.check-failed.title.en: Couldn’t check for updates (network, source, or rate limit)
panel.failure.check-failed.title.zh: 版本信息查询失败（网络 / 数据源 / 限流）

panel.failure.install-failed.action.en: Read the copied diagnostics first; on official desktop builds, send it to the plugin author.
panel.failure.install-failed.action.zh: 请查阅诊断摘要；官方桌面版请提交该诊断信息至插件作者

panel.failure.install-failed.title.zh: 安装执行失败，详情见诊断摘要

panel.failure.internal.action.en: Retry once first; if it persists, send the copied diagnostics to the plugin author.
panel.failure.internal.action.zh: 请重试一次；若持续，请提交诊断信息至插件作者

panel.failure.internal.title.en: Something went wrong; the cause is unknown

panel.failure.invalid-release.action.en: Check the package name and version in the manifest, then check again.
panel.failure.invalid-release.action.zh: 核对清单文件中的包名与版本声明后重新查询

panel.failure.invalid-release.title.en: Release info is invalid (bad version or mismatched content)
panel.failure.invalid-release.title.zh: 发布版本信息无效（版本号非法或内容不一致）

panel.failure.unknown.action.en: Retry once first; if it persists, send the copied diagnostics to the plugin author (include the code you saw).
panel.failure.unknown.action.zh: 请重试一次；若持续，请提交诊断信息至插件作者（请一并提交所见错误码）

panel.failure.unknown.title.en: Something went wrong; the cause is unknown

panel.failure.update-busy.action.en: Wait until the current task leaves installing/verifying, then try; check status for your queue position.
panel.failure.update-busy.action.zh: 待当前任务退出 installing/verifying 状态后重试；排队期间可查询任务状态确认队列位置

panel.failure.update-busy.title.en: Another install is running in the same scope
panel.failure.update-busy.title.zh: 同一使用范围内存在进行中的安装任务

panel.footer.close-title.en: Close the window; updates keep running
panel.footer.close-title.zh: 关闭窗口，更新不受影响

panel.footer.note.en: Closing never interrupts updates; come back anytime
panel.footer.note.zh: 关闭窗口，更新不受影响，可随时返回查看。

panel.manual.absent.en: No manual command available (unrecognized scope or source install).
panel.manual.absent.zh: 当前没有可用的手工命令（使用范围无法识别或源码安装场景不提供）。

panel.manual.heading.en: Manual fallback command (copy the full line to run):
panel.manual.heading.zh: 手工备用命令（请复制整行执行）：

panel.manual.updater-nested.en: This panel runs a nested copy of the updater ({version}), pinned by the plugin that declares it; update that plugin first (this panel picks up a newer updater only after that plugin widens its range). You can also install the updater at the profile level with the carrier CLI so other plugins sharing that copy get the fixes first: {command}
panel.manual.updater-nested.zh: 本面板的更新器是嵌套副本（{version}），由声明它的插件钉住；请先更新那个插件（它发版抬了依赖范围后，本面板才会换新）。也可用载体命令行把更新器装到使用范围级，让共用那一份的其他插件先拿到修复：{command}

panel.manual.updater-nested-nocmd.en: This panel runs a nested copy of the updater ({version}), pinned by the plugin that declares it; update that plugin first (this panel picks up a newer updater only after that plugin widens its range).
panel.manual.updater-nested-nocmd.zh: 本面板的更新器是嵌套副本（{version}），由声明它的插件钉住；请先更新那个插件（它发版抬了依赖范围后，本面板才会换新）。

panel.queue.busy-other.en: Another plugin is installing; retry later.
panel.queue.busy-other.zh: 前方有其他插件正在安装，请稍后重试。

panel.queue.busy-queued.en: An install is running ahead; this plugin is #{n} in queue. Install when it reaches the front.
panel.queue.busy-queued.zh: 前方有安装正在进行，本插件排第 {n} 位；到队首后请选择安装。

panel.queue.empty.en: No queued tasks; one install per scope at a time.
panel.queue.empty.zh: 当前无排队任务；同一使用范围同时仅安装一项。

panel.queue.row-idle-note.en: One install per scope at a time
panel.queue.row-idle-note.zh: 同一使用范围同时仅安装一项

panel.queue.row-installing-note.en: You are next when it finishes
panel.queue.row-installing-note.zh: 安装完成后自动轮到你

panel.skip.line-note.en: Select “Restore” to undo; this version will remind again.
panel.skip.line-note.zh: 选择「恢复提醒」可撤销，该版本此后仍会提醒。

panel.skip.skipped-action.en: Select “Restore” to be reminded of this version again; newer versions will still notify.
panel.skip.skipped-action.zh: 选择「恢复提醒」可重新提醒该版本；更新的版本仍会正常提醒。

panel.toast.copy-diag-fail.en: Copy failed; please select the info above manually.
panel.toast.copy-diag-fail.zh: 复制失败，请手动选择上方信息。

panel.toast.copy-diag-ok.en: Diagnostics copied; paste it to the plugin author (already redacted).
panel.toast.copy-diag-ok.zh: 诊断信息已复制，请提交至插件作者（已脱敏）。

panel.toast.copy-manual-fail.en: Copy failed; please select the command above manually.
panel.toast.copy-manual-fail.zh: 复制失败，请手动选择上方命令。

panel.toast.copy-manual-ok.en: Manual command copied; paste the full line into the terminal to run it.
panel.toast.copy-manual-ok.zh: 手工命令已复制，请粘贴至终端整行执行。

panel.toast.copy-state-ok.en: Current state copied (no failure); paste it to the plugin author (already redacted).
panel.toast.copy-state-ok.zh: 当前状态已复制（无失败），请提交至插件作者（已脱敏）。

panel.toast.failure-dismissed.en: Failure acknowledged; it will be re-evaluated on the next check or install.
panel.toast.failure-dismissed.zh: 已确认该失败提示；下次查询版本信息或安装将重新评估。

panel.toast.fallback-unavailable.en: No compliant build for this failure; see the diagnostics or retry later.
panel.toast.fallback-unavailable.zh: 这次失败用不上合规版，请看诊断信息或稍后重试。

panel.toast.fallback-wait.en: Latest should clear around {time}; no earlier compliant build for now.
panel.toast.fallback-wait.zh: 最新版约 {time} 可装，暂无更早的合规版。

panel.toast.restart-delegated.en: Handled by the caller’s restart flow; the new version takes effect after restart.
panel.toast.restart-delegated.zh: 已按调用方重启流程处理；重启后新版本生效。

panel.toast.restart-failed.en: Restart entry failed; please restart the host manually. The new version takes effect after restart.
panel.toast.restart-failed.zh: 重启入口调用失败，请手动重启宿主；重启后新版本生效。

panel.toast.restart-manual.en: This host provides no restart entry; please restart the host manually. The new version takes effect after restart.
panel.toast.restart-manual.zh: 本宿主未提供重启入口，请手动重启宿主；重启后新版本生效。
